description_en: Lists the materialized views in a project
kebab_example: aliyun sls list-materialized-view --project example-string --name example-string --offset 1 --size 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMaterializedView

parameters.description_en: The project that contains the materialized views.
parameters.help_en: The project that contains the materialized views
parameters.name: project

parameters.description_en: The name of the materialized view. Use this to query for a specific materialized view.
parameters.help_en: The name of the materialized view. Use this to query for a specific materialized view
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The number of entries to skip before returning results. This parameter is used for pagination. Default value: 0.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip before returning results. This parameter is used for pagination. Default value: 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of materialized views to return per page. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 500.
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of materialized views to return per page. Default value: 100. Maximum value: 500
parameters.name: size
